infobox.usage: This key does currently not open any safe.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Store safe key (Safe) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the safe inside one of the village stores, located somewhere near the Azure Coast sanatorium.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: There is no locked safe on Shoreline that requires this key.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs
